{{Quote|Limna is one of the Kerestians born in the blood of her planet's downfall. She survived in the savage wastes by murder and treachery ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|A Galactic Empire file on Limna Yith|<ref name="Sisar">{{WEGCite|story=The Barani Conspiracy|book=Secrets of the Sisar Run}}</ref>}}
'''Kerest''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At one point more than a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Kerestians [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] the nearby [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Karoliston]] and [[Pharna]] and launched multiple [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]]-speed [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] toward distant [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

Less than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, the [[Kerestian sun|sun]] of the [[Kerest system/Legends|Kerest system]] unexpectedly began to [[Temperature/Legends|cool]], resulting in rapid temperature decrease on Kerest. Most of the planet's surface became covered by thick [[Water/Legends|glaciers]], and over the subsequent centuries, the Kerestians that survived there reverted to a primitive, barbaric state. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], those Kerestians&mdash;known as relentless [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]]&mdash;who left Kerest frequently became employed as [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

==Description==
[[File:Sluis_sector.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Kerest was situated in the Sluis sector.]]
Kerest was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG12" /> located in the [[Kerest system/Legends|Kerest system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that lay far from any commonly traveled [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]]&ndash;type [[Kerestian sun|star]] and was located near the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Karoliston]] and [[Pharna]].<ref name="GG12" />

Kerest was inhabited by several [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals,<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> with a type of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivore]] at one point giving rise to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestians]]. After the rapid onset of a severe period of [[Water/Legends|glaciation]] from which the dying world never recovered, most of Kerest's surface&mdash;save for a narrow band of inhabitable land around its equator&mdash;became covered under glaciers that were hundreds of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] thick.<ref name="GG12" /> Only a small number of Kerest's animal species were able to survive the cataclysm by adapting to the [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] conditions.<ref name="NEGWT" />

==History==
===The disaster===
[[File:Mandalore_The_Ultimate_by_Darren_Tan.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A member of Kerest's Kerestian species (lower right; second from right) once joined the offworld Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders.]]
At some point between [[3996 BBY]] and [[3960 BBY]],<ref name="Mandalorian dates">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' depicts a [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] member of the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] at one point during the reign of [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], which the book establishes to have [[Battle of Malachor V|ended]] in [[3960 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' in turn dates the [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|beginning]] of said reign to [[3996 BBY]].</ref> a member of<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the Kerestian species of Kerest<ref name="GG12" /> joined the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] movement of the interstellar [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="EGTW" /> The Kerestians at one point [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] the habitable moons Karoliston and Pharna. Eventually, they also launched several dozen [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]] equipped with [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and filled with Kerestians in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] toward distant [[Star/Legends|star]] systems they hoped to settle.<ref name="GG12" />

Nearly a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later,<ref name="GG12" /> more than one [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="UAA" /> the Kerestian sun entered an unusual cycle of activity and began to cool within a single [[Local year|year]]. As a result, most of Kerest's surface rapidly became covered in expansive glaciers that buried much of the Kerestian society's technology.<ref name="GG12" /> Several groups of Kerestians evacuated the planet and once again left their star system aboard sublight-speed [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="UAA" />

Those Kerestians that remained on their homeworld and survived the cataclysm reverted to a state of primitive barbarism, with the memories of their civilization's past technologies buried under the planet's glaciers being relegated in the process to the status of vague and inaccurate fables. Over the subsequent hundreds of years, the Kerestians on Kerest [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] each other<ref name="GG12" /> for [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and sport,<ref name="UAA" /> gradually pushing the species toward extinction.<ref name="GG12" />

===Interactions with offworlders===
[[File:NarissSivLoqesh-HTH.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Kerestian bounty hunter Nariss Siv Loqesh was born on Kerest.]]
Eventually, a [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] starship arrived in Kerest's orbit after an error by its [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] deposited it in the star system. The Tagge ship's crew subsequently offered to transport a handful of the fiercest Kerestians off Kerest in return for serving the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]&mdash;a privilege that the natives proceeded to fight each other over. Later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also recruited Kerestians to serve Imperial officials and nobility as messengers and combatants.<ref name="GG12" />

The Kerestian [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref> [[Andov Syn|Nariss Siv Loqesh]], who would later be known as Andov Syn,<ref name="Galaxy6">{{GalaxyCite|6|Hunting the Hunters}}</ref> was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Kerest<ref name="WbC" /> in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="WbCdates">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which establishes [[Andov Syn]] to be thirty-eight [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, is dated to three years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], and Syn must have been [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> and the Kerestian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Limna Yith]] likewise hailed from the planet, with an Imperial file on Yith during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] claiming that she had used [[Death/Legends|murder]] and treachery to survive on Kerest's wastes.<ref name="Sisar" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="WbCdates" /> Kerest was mentioned by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] within the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' in an entry dedicated to Syn.<ref name="WbC" />

{{RPGseed}}
At some point during the Galactic Civil War, a group of individuals discovered one of the centuries-old Kerestian colony ships. After they were released from suspended animation in [[cryotank]]s, the Kerestians aboard the vessel guided the group in recovering unusual and valuable pieces of lost Kerestian technology from beneath the glaciers on Kerest, Karoliston, and Pharna.<ref name="GG12" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Kerestian/Legends}}
[[File:Kerestian_UAA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kerest was the homeworld of the Kerestian species.]]
Kerest was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Kerestians, sentient [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]<ref name="GG12" /> who spoke the [[Kerestese]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="UAA" /> Prior to the cataclysm that befell Kerest, the Kerestians had an industrial civilization that developed [[nuclear fusion]] power, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology, and sublight [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel capability.<ref name="GG12" /> The Kerestians of that [[Time/Legends|time]] were interested in art, [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]], and exploration,<ref name="UAA" /> and those that were awakened from suspended animation centuries later were stunned and saddened to learn of the fate of their homeworld and civilization.<ref name="GG12" />

Following the glaciation of Kerest, the Kerestians residing there struggled to survive, subsisting on the few animal species<ref name="NEGWT" />&mdash;as well as other Kerestians<ref name="GG12" />&mdash;that were available for hunting.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Due to the hostile conditions on their homeworld, few Kerestian [[Youngling/Legends|young]] were born, and the species moved toward extinction as a result.<ref name="GG12" />

By the time of the Galactic Civil War, it was thought that natural selection on the planet had favored the most merciless Kerestians,<ref name="GG12" /> and the species eventually achieved the reputation of brutal, relentless hunters.<ref name="UAA" /> The Kerestians who had left the planet aboard colony ships were shocked by the barbarity displayed by the members of the species who had remained on Kerest.<ref name="GG12" /> Kerestians who became weary of living on Kerest frequently found work offworld as mercenaries and [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters.<ref name="UAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kerest was first mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[1995]] ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'' includes a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure seed that is written by [[Lisa Smedman]] and features Kerest as a setting. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kerest system, and therefore the planet, in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA" />
